questions.title: 筛选高价值已付款订单
questions.desc: 找出状态为 paid、且金额大于 100 的订单，按金额从高到低排列，输出订单号和金额。
questions.hint: 两个条件同时满足用 AND，排序用 order by ... desc。
questions.answer: select order_id, amount from orders where status = 'paid' and amount > 100 order by amount desc;

questions.title: 各城市订单数量
questions.desc: 统计每个城市的订单笔数，从多到少排列，输出城市和笔数。
questions.hint: 按城市分组，用 count(*) 数笔数，再按数量降序。
questions.answer: select city, count(*) as order_count from orders group by city order by order_count desc;

questions.title: 每个客户的消费总额（含零消费客户）
questions.desc: 列出所有客户及其订单总金额。没有下过单的客户也要列出来，金额显示 0。按总额从高到低排列。
questions.hint: 顾客表在左、订单表在右做左连接，金额用 coalesce 把 NULL 补成 0。
questions.answer: select c.name, coalesce(sum(o.amount), 0) as total from customers c left join orders o on c.customer_id = o.customer_id group by c.name order by total desc;

questions.title: 每个城市金额最高的订单
questions.desc: 找出每个城市金额最大的那一笔订单，输出订单号、城市和金额。金额相同的都算。
questions.hint: 用 row_number() over (partition by 城市 order by 金额 desc) 排个序，再筛第一名。
questions.answer: select order_id, city, amount from (select *, row_number() over (partition by city order by amount desc) as rn from orders) t where rn = 1 order by city;

questions.title: 2 月的订单量和总额
questions.desc: 统计 2024 年 2 月的订单笔数和金额合计，输出两列。
questions.hint: 用 order_date >= date '2024-02-01' and order_date < date '2024-03-01' 圈定范围，别用字符串比较。
questions.answer: select count(*) as order_count, sum(amount) as total_amount from orders where order_date >= date '2024-02-01' and order_date < date '2024-03-01';
